say:3:1810504001:0.text: I-It's really Miss Senea herself! S-So beautiful...
say:3:1810504001:0.source_cn: 是塞塞塞塞涅小姐本人……！真真真真真漂亮啊……

say:4:1810504002:0.text: Sorry, we didn't see you there! You're not hurt, are you?
say:4:1810504002:0.source_cn: 对不起，塞涅小姐，我们没看到你过来……刚才没伤着你吧？

say:7:1810504003:0.text: Almost! An arrow landed right at Miss Senea's feet!
say:7:1810504003:0.source_cn: 差一点就伤着了！有一支箭就落在塞涅脚边！

say:8:1810504004:0.text: What?! We're so sorry! We didn't mean it!
say:8:1810504004:0.source_cn: 啊？！对不起对不起对不起！塞涅小姐，我们不是故意的！

say:9:1810504005:0.text: Please don't worry. I won't mention what happened to Lady Tephesia.
say:9:1810504005:0.source_cn: 请不必紧张，我不会将刚才发生的事告诉苔佩希阁下。

say:10:1810504006:0.text: In exchange, could you be lenient and let these friends of mine go?
say:10:1810504006:0.source_cn: 作为交换，可否请你们高抬贵手，放过面前这几位朋友？

say:11:1810504007:1.text: But... they're connected to the Repair House, and they're acting suspiciously...
say:11:1810504007:1.source_cn: 这……可是他们和修缮屋有关，行迹可疑……

say:12:1810504008:0.text: Fine, don't let them go. I'll tell everyone you were badmouthing Lady Novaris!
say:12:1810504008:0.source_cn: 好啊，你们不放人，那我就告诉所有人，你说了领主的坏话！

say:14:1810504010:0.text: Is it? I wonder whose word she would trust more—Miss Senea's, or ordinary guards like you?
say:14:1810504010:0.source_cn: 有吗？不知道领主阁下更愿意听塞涅小姐的话，还是你们这些...

say:15:1810504011:0.text: They attended my death anniversary performance. One of them was even a lead performer. Please make an exception.
say:15:1810504011:0.source_cn: 他们是曾看过我“忌辰”演出的观众，甚至还有一位曾是主演...
say:15:1810504011:0.male: They attended my death anniversary performance. One of them was even a lead performer. Please make an exception.
say:15:1810504011:0.female: They attended my death anniversary performance. One of them was even a lead performer. Please make an exception.
